Cell 2: Pale first-fried thick chips draining in a single layer on a wire rack, cooked but not browned.

Cell 4: Four dry white-fish portions lightly dusted with flour on a tray, no wet patches and no hands.
Cell 5: Two finished battered fish fillets resting on a wire rack, deeply golden with an airy rough crisp crust; no utensils or hands.
Cell 6: Deep-golden thick chips draining on a rack in one crisp layer, visibly darker than the first-fried stage.
